beats.text: Six tiny habits that look like nothing — and change everything over a year.
One. Make your bed. You win the very first task of the day before it fights back.
Two. Walk twenty minutes. It's the closest thing we have to a wonder drug.
Three. Read ten pages a day. That's around fifteen books a year, almost by accident.
Four. Write down three things you're grateful for. You train the eye to find them.
Five. Drink a glass of water before your coffee. Small, dull, and you'll feel it.
Six. Put the phone away an hour before sleep. Protect the night, and the day repays you.
None of these impress anyone today. In a year, they quietly build a different person.
